page_title: BUR 0-1 CRY | Burnley v Crystal Palace 03/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+5' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Thomas Kirk had a clear view and blows his whistle.

90+3' Armando Broja (Burnley) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Substitution. Daichi Kamada makes his way off the pitch and Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) comes on as his replacement.
88' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
86' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) jumps into a tackle and Thomas Kirk signals a foul. Burnley are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
84' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
82' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
81' It will be a substitution. Armando Broja (Burnley) is ready to enter the pitch as Josh Cullen walks off.
81' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
80' Burnley seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Lyle Foster (Burnley) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) coming on for Adam Wharton.
76' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
75' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
73' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
71' The substitution is prepared. Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florentino.
71' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
69' Florentino (Burnley) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
66' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
64' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Yeremy Pino and he is replaced by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace).
64' Substitution. Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) on for Jean-Philippe Mateta.
64' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
64' Burnley take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' Lyle Foster (Burnley) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Burnley earn a corner.
62' The ball is cleared after Marcus Edwards (Burnley) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Lyle Foster (Burnley) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
60' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) comes onto the pitch for Zian Flemming.
58' Here is a change. Jaidon Anthony is going off and Scott Parker gives the last tactical orders to Marcus Edwards (Burnley).
57' Martin Dubravka pulls off a great save to deny Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
55' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
54' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
52' Flag goes up against Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lyle Foster (Burnley).
50' A pass into the penalty area from Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by the defence.
49' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
48' Kyle Walker (Burnley) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
47' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Scott Parker probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Loum Tchaouna (Burnley). He is replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Thomas Kirk blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Marc Guehi and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 0:1.
43' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
42' Lyle Foster (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
41' Thomas Kirk interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
39' Martin Dubravka (Burnley) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Looks like Martin Dubravka (Burnley) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
38' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
38' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Crystal Palace force a corner. They send men into the box.
35' Zian Flemming (Burnley) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
34' Referee Thomas Kirk signals NO PENALTY for Burnley after a VAR review!
34' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Burnley! Let's see what he decides.
33' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
31' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
29' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
27' Kyle Walker (Burnley) tackles a bit over-zealously and Thomas Kirk blows for a foul. Crystal Palace have a free kick.
27' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
24' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
20' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kyle Walker (Burnley) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
17' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.

16' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Good work from Burnley as they win a corner.
15' The corner from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by Martin Dubravka.

14' Martin Dubravka pulls off a great save to deny Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Zian Flemming (Burnley) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
12' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
11' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
9' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) commits a foul and Thomas Kirk immediately signals a free kick.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Zian Flemming (Burnley) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
4' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Burnley control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has started.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
